title: Engage in legal practice only as an Australian legal practitioner
what: Engage in legal practice only as an Australian legal practitioner (a lawyer with a current practising certificate), or as the Act otherwise allows.

sources.title: Legal Profession Act 2006 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 16(1) (current republication (R45, from 16 May 2026; Legal Profession Act 2006 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person engages in legal practice in the ACT; and (b) the person is not an Australian legal practitioner
